questions.prompt: An ACR registry uses RBAC Registry + ABAC Repository Permissions. A workload with only AcrPull cannot pull the known repository apps/web. Connectivity and authentication succeed. It must read that repository without permission to push, delete, or list every repository. Which role configuration addresses the authorization gap?

options.text: Container Registry Repository Reader with a condition covering apps/web.
options.explanation: Repository Reader grants image read/pull in ABAC mode, and the condition limits repository access without adding catalog-listing or write permissions.

options.text: AcrPull reassigned at the registry scope.
options.explanation: Legacy AcrPull is not honored in this registry mode; reassigning it does not grant repository pull access.

options.text: Container Registry Repository Catalog Lister only.
options.explanation: Catalog listing exposes repository names; it does not grant image pull and exceeds the stated listing requirement.

options.text: Reader on the registry resource only.
options.explanation: Control-plane Reader does not authorize repository image access in this mode.

questions.prompt: A deployment must refer to the exact same container image content after a tag is reassigned. Which identifier should it record?

options.explanation: A digest identifies content rather than a mutable tag label.
latest is a mutable tag and may refer to different content later.
A repository can contain many image versions.
A management container does not identify image content.

questions.prompt: An App Service app must pull a private image from an ACR registry using RBAC Registry Permissions mode. The app has a system-assigned managed identity and network access to the registry, which accepts ARM-audience tokens. It must pull without storing a registry password or granting push permission. Which configuration meets the requirements?

options.text: Configure managed-identity image pulls and grant the app identity AcrPull on the registry.
options.explanation: App Service supports managed-identity pulls. AcrPull authorizes read/pull in the stated registry mode without granting push.

options.text: Configure managed-identity image pulls and grant the app identity Reader on the registry.
options.explanation: Control-plane Reader does not supply the image pull permission needed by the app.

options.text: Configure registry admin credentials as the app image-pull credentials.
options.explanation: The admin account uses a shared registry password, which the requirement excludes.

options.text: Configure managed-identity image pulls and grant the app identity AcrPush on the registry.
options.explanation: AcrPush includes push permission; that exceeds the stated pull-only requirement.
